mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person_qualification_answer (workspace_id, person_id, criterion_id, answer, answered_by_id, answered_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{personId}, #{criterionId}, #{answer}, #{answeredById}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answer = VALUES(answer), answered_by_id = VALUES(answered_by_id), answered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
